hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == */lib/* ]] && [[ "$f" != *.test.ts ]]; then base="${f%.ts}"; testfile="${base}.test.ts"; if [ ! -f "$testfile" ]; then printf '{"systemMessage":"Warning: %s does not exist — add a test for this lib/ file."}' "$testfile"; fi; fi; }
npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test || (echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Quality checks failed (typecheck/lint/test). Fix errors before pushing."}'; exit 1)
